name: Text-message opt-in check
summary: Before a text campaign goes out, the marketing lead sees every number on the proposed list beside the opt-in your own records hold for it: where it was given, when, and the wording as recorded. Anyone with no recorded opt-in, or with a recorded opt-out, is held out and counted. A person decides who is sent to.

sources.title: Its own method for checking a proposed text campaign list against a company's recorded opt-ins and opt-outs, number by number, for the owner's decision.
